title: Act: Extract a single focused-id helper in BootScene
summary: Use one private helper for the store write and the event payload
description: Replace the inline focused-id lookup in onKeyDown with a private focusedObjectIdFromScene method returning string | null.
acceptance_criteria: Helper returns null when no object isFocused.
Store write and event use the helper result.
definition_of_done: onKeyDown calls the helper once per move

steps.action: Add a private method focusedObjectIdFromScene(): string | null returning this.sceneObjects.find((o) => o.isFocused)?.spec.id ?? null.
steps.code: private focusedObjectIdFromScene(): string | null { return this.sceneObjects.find((o) => o.isFocused)?.spec.id ?? null; }

steps.action: Replace the inline find in the delta branch with `const id = this.focusedObjectIdFromScene();` and use id for setFocusedObject and the focusChange emit.
steps.expected: Store write and event share one computed id.
